title: Align canonical path-output contracts
summary: Align Windows path-output contract assertions with the canonical resolved paths emitted by existing safety and containment helpers.
reason: GitHub's Windows runner resolves the RUNNER~1 alias to its long path, while a small set of tests still asserted the raw temporary-directory spelling.
behavior_before: The affected tests compared returned canonical paths with the raw spelling supplied to the helper, so they failed when the operating system expanded a Windows 8.3 alias.
behavior_after: The affected tests assert the canonical resolved path that each existing helper is documented and implemented to return, without changing production path handling.
